# Libraries and directories

```{r}
library(tidyverse) #v2.0.0
library(tidymodels) #v1.4.1
library(openxlsx) #v4.2.8
library(patchwork) #v1.3.2
library(ggcorrplot) #v0.1.4.1

tidymodels_prefer()  # resolve function conflicts in favour of tidymodels

set.seed(123)

# list of input/output directories
indir <- "./indir"
rbt_v1_dir <- "./Rebuttal/outdir" # directory to the results from the first rebuttal
blwgcna_dir <- "./outdir/bl_wgcna"
nduf_assoc_dir <- "./outdir/nduf_assoc_de"

# output directory
outdir <- "./Rebuttal_3rd"

source("./Codes/fns.R") #source a list of frequently used functions
```

# File prep
```{r}
comTrait <- readRDS(paste0(indir,"/comTrait.rds")) # resilience status were determined in Rebuttal/rbt_2_1_3_BF_TM.Rmd

comRes <- readRDS(paste0(rbt_v1_dir, "/1_11/comRes_Combat.rds")) # use the combat adjusted residuals since we are training in one dataset and test in another dataset; from Rebuttal/rbt_1_11.R
nduf_bb <- read.csv(paste0(nduf_assoc_dir, "/nduf_bb.csv")) #generated in 4_nduf_assoc_de.R

# select the residuals of NDUFs
nduf_res <- comRes[,nduf_bb$gene_id]
nduf_res <- data.frame(nduf_res)
# rename geneID to gene name of NDUFs
nduf_res  <- nduf_res  %>% rename_at(vars(1:(ncol(.))), ~ nduf_bb$gene_name[match(names(nduf_res)[1:(ncol(nduf_res))], nduf_bb$gene_id)])

# prepare input dataframes
mcsa_input <- comTrait[1:105,] %>% 
  rownames_to_column("SubjectID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(SubjectID, Sex, Educ, Age, APOE4, starts_with("Res_")) %>% 
  left_join(nduf_res %>% rownames_to_column("SubjectID")) %>% 
  mutate(APOE4 = factor(APOE4)) %>% 
  mutate(across(
    starts_with("Res_X."),
    ~ factor(.x, levels = c("Resilient", "Non-resilient"))
  ))

adni_input <- comTrait[106:196,] %>% 
  rownames_to_column("SubjectID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(SubjectID, Sex, Educ, Age, APOE4, starts_with("Res_")) %>% 
  left_join(nduf_res %>% rownames_to_column("SubjectID")) %>% 
  mutate(APOE4 = factor(APOE4)) %>% 
  mutate(across(
    starts_with("Res_X."),
    ~ factor(.x, levels = c("Resilient", "Non-resilient"))
  ))


```

# predictive modeling functions

Adopted from: <https://lsinks.github.io/posts/2023-04-10-tidymodels/tidymodels_tutorial.html#defining-the-model-with-parsnip>

```{r classification}

modeling <- function(
    train_data,
    test_data,
    outcome_col,
    covar_col,
    gene_col,
    mode = c("separate", "all") # test all or separate genes at a time
){
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  
  # remove any NA and select only needed columns
  train_data <- train_data %>% 
    drop_na(outcome_col, covar_col, gene_col) %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(outcome_col, covar_col, gene_col))) 
  
  test_data <- test_data %>% 
    drop_na(outcome_col, covar_col, gene_col) %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(c(outcome_col, covar_col, gene_col))) 
  
  # create data_split 
  data_split <- make_splits(
    x = train_data,   
    assessment = test_data
  )
  
  # set up dataframe for metrics and coefficients ----
  metrics <- data.frame()
  coefs   <- data.frame()
  preds   <- data.frame()
  auc_comp<- data.frame()
  
  # Define ----
  ## 1) models ----
  ### standard logistic regression
  logreg_spec <- 
    logistic_reg() %>% 
    set_engine("glm") %>% 
    set_mode("classification")
  
  ### ridge regularization
  ridge_spec <- 
    logistic_reg(penalty = tune(),
                 mixture = 0) %>%
    set_engine("glmnet") %>% 
    set_mode("classification")
  
  ### elastic net regularization
  en_spec <- 
    logistic_reg(penalty = tune(),
                 mixture = tune()) %>%
    set_engine("glmnet") %>% 
    set_mode("classification")
  
  ## 2) metrics to evaluate ----
  custom_metric_set = metric_set(roc_auc, sensitivity, specificity, brier_class)
  
  ## 3) formula ----
  formula_cov = as.formula(paste0(outcome_col, " ~ Sex + Educ + Age + APOE4"))
  formula_full = as.formula(paste0(outcome_col, " ~ ", paste0(c(covar_col, gene_col), collapse = " + ")))
  formula_gene = as.formula(paste0(outcome_col, " ~ ", paste0(gene_col, collapse = " + ")))
  
  ## 4) Create recipe ----
  recipe_cov <- recipe(formula_cov, data = train_data) %>% 
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  recipe_full <- recipe(formula_full, data = train_data) %>% 
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  recipe_gene <- recipe(formula_gene, data = train_data) %>% 
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
    step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>% 
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
  
  ## Helper functions ----
  ### define metrics calculation function
  cal_metrics <- function(data, prob_col, class_col){
    
    metric_data <- tibble(
      truth = data$truth,
      pred_class = data[[class_col]],
      probability = data[[prob_col]]
    )
    
    # yardstick metrics
    yardstick_metrics <- custom_metric_set(
      metric_data,
      truth = truth,
      estimate = pred_class,
      probability
    ) %>%
      dplyr::select(.metric, .estimate)
    
    # calibration
    y_num   <- as.numeric(metric_data$truth == levels(metric_data$truth)[1])
    cal <- rms::val.prob(metric_data$probability, y_num, pl = F)
    calibration <- 
      tibble(".metric" = c("calibration_intercept", "calibration_slope"),
             ".estimate" = c(cal[["Intercept"]], cal[["Slope"]])
      )
    
    bind_rows(
      yardstick_metrics,
      calibration
    )
  }
  
  ### calculate 95% CI of metrics using bootstrapping
  ### get the idea from rsample::int_pctl: https://github.com/tidymodels/rsample/blob/main/R/bootci.R#L301
  ### internal function: https://rdrr.io/cran/rsample/src/R/bootci.R#sym-pctl_single
   boostrap_ci_fn <- function(dat, times = 1000, alpha = 0.05, seed = 1){
    set.seed(seed)
    boots <- rsample::bootstraps(dat, times = times, strata = truth)

    ## calculate all models within every same bootstrap
    boot_results <- boots %>%
      mutate(
        results = map(
          splits,
          function(split) {
            d <- analysis(split)

            cov_results <- cal_metrics(d, prob_col = ".pred_prob_cov", class_col = ".pred_class_cov") %>% dplyr::rename(.estimate_cov = .estimate)
            full_results <- cal_metrics(d, prob_col = ".pred_prob_full", class_col = ".pred_class_full") %>% dplyr::rename(.estimate_full = .estimate)
            gene_results <- cal_metrics(d, prob_col = ".pred_prob_gene", class_col = ".pred_class_gene") %>% dplyr::rename(.estimate_gene = .estimate)

            cov_results %>% 
              left_join(full_results, by = ".metric") %>%
              left_join(gene_results, by = ".metric") %>% 
              mutate(delta_metric = .estimate_full - .estimate_cov)
          }
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(id, results) %>%
      unnest(results)

    ## get the percentile boostrap 95% CI
    bootstrap_ci <- boot_results %>%
      group_by(.metric) %>%
      summarise(
        cov_L95 = quantile(.estimate_cov, alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),
        cov_H95 = quantile(.estimate_cov, 1 - alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),

        full_L95 = quantile(.estimate_full, alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),
        full_H95 = quantile(.estimate_full, 1 - alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),
        
        gene_L95 = quantile(.estimate_gene, alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),
        gene_H95 = quantile(.estimate_gene, 1 - alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),

        delta_L95 = quantile(delta_metric, alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),
        delta_H95 = quantile(delta_metric, 1 - alpha/2, na.rm = TRUE),

        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
  
  ### Perform AUC/ROC test
  roc_sig_test <- function(dat, seed = 1){
    roc_cov <- pROC::roc(dat$truth, dat$.pred_prob_cov, levels = rev(levels(dat$truth)), direction = "<")
    roc_full <- pROC::roc(dat$truth, dat$.pred_prob_full, levels = rev(levels(dat$truth)), direction = "<")
    
    set.seed(1)
    venkatram <- pROC::roc.test(roc_cov, roc_full,
                                method = "venkatraman",   # permutation test
                                paired = TRUE,            # correct here — same subjects, two prediction sets
                                boot.n = 2000              # number of permutations
    )
    delong <- pROC::roc.test(roc_cov, roc_full,
                             method = "delong",   # permutation test
                             paired = TRUE            # correct here — same subjects, two prediction sets
    )
    auc_comp <- tibble("Venkatram" = venkatram$p.value, "DeLong" = delong$p.value)
  }
  
  ## fit the model (mode = separate) ----
  if (mode == "separate"){
    
    ## create workflow
    wf_cov <- workflow() %>% 
      add_recipe(recipe_cov) %>% 
      add_model(logreg_spec)
    wf_full <- workflow() %>% 
      add_recipe(recipe_full) %>% 
      add_model(logreg_spec)
    wf_gene <- workflow() %>% 
      add_recipe(recipe_gene) %>% 
      add_model(logreg_spec)
    
    ## fitting
    last_fit_cov <- last_fit(wf_cov, data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    last_fit_full <- last_fit(wf_full, data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    last_fit_gene <- last_fit(wf_gene, data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    ## collect coefficients (establish from train_data)
    coefs <- rbind(
      coefs,
      last_fit_cov %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(covariate_only = TRUE),
      last_fit_full %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(covariate_only = FALSE),
      last_fit_gene %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(covariate_only = FALSE)
    )
    
    ## collect predictions (prediction on test_data)
    pred_cur_cov <- last_fit_cov %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_cov = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_cov = .pred_class, truth = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_full <- last_fit_full %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_full = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_full = .pred_class, truth_full = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_gene <- last_fit_gene %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_gene = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_gene = .pred_class, truth_gene = {{outcome_col}})
    
    pred_cur <- pred_cur_cov %>% left_join(pred_cur_full, by = ".row") %>% left_join(pred_cur_gene, by = ".row") %>% mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    
    # Check that truth is identical
    if (!all(
      pred_cur$truth == pred_cur$truth_full & pred_cur$truth_full == pred_cur$truth_gene
    )) {
      stop(
        "The three last_fit objects do not appear to contain
       predictions for the same observations in the same order."
      )
    }
    
    preds <- rbind(
      preds,
      pred_cur
    ) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-truth_full, -truth_gene) %>% 
      relocate(.row, .before = "truth")
    
    ## collect metrics (evaluated on test_data)
    ### get the point estimates
    point_cov <- cal_metrics(pred_cur, prob_col = ".pred_prob_cov", class_col = ".pred_class_cov") %>% rename(.estimate_cov = .estimate)
    point_full <- cal_metrics(pred_cur, prob_col = ".pred_prob_full", class_col = ".pred_class_full") %>% rename(.estimate_full = .estimate)
    point_gene <- cal_metrics(pred_cur, prob_col = ".pred_prob_gene", class_col = ".pred_class_gene") %>% rename(.estimate_gene = .estimate)
    point <- point_cov %>% left_join(point_full, by = ".metric") %>% left_join(point_gene, by = ".metric") %>% mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    
    metrics <- rbind(
      metrics,
      point
    ) %>% 
      mutate(delta_metric = .estimate_full - .estimate_cov, .after = ".estimate_full")
    
    ## calculate 95% CI of metrics
    boots <- boostrap_ci_fn(dat = pred_cur) %>% mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    
    metrics <- metrics %>%
      left_join(boots, by = c(".metric", "model_type")) %>%
      dplyr::select(model_type, .metric, everything())
    
    
    ## perform ROC AUC test
    auc_comp_cur = roc_sig_test(dat = pred_cur) %>% mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    
    auc_comp <- rbind(
      auc_comp,
      auc_comp_cur
    )
    
  }
  
  ## fit the model (mode = all) ----
  else if (mode == "all"){
    ## create workflow
    wf_tune_cov <- 
      workflow_set(
        list(data = recipe_cov),
        list(logreg = logreg_spec, ridge = ridge_spec, en = en_spec)
      )
    wf_tune_full <- 
      workflow_set(
        list(data = recipe_full),
        list(logreg = logreg_spec, ridge = ridge_spec, en = en_spec)
      )
    wf_tune_gene <- 
      workflow_set(
        list(data = recipe_gene),
        list(logreg = logreg_spec, ridge = ridge_spec, en = en_spec)
      )
    
    ## tuning
    set.seed(1234)
    folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 10, strata = outcome_col)
    tune_results_cov <- 
      workflow_map(
        wf_tune_cov,
        "tune_grid",
        resamples = folds,
        grid = 10,
        metrics = custom_metric_set,
        verbose = F
      )
    tune_results_full <- 
      workflow_map(
        wf_tune_full,
        "tune_grid",
        resamples = folds,
        grid = 10,
        metrics = custom_metric_set,
        verbose = F
      )
    tune_results_gene <- 
      workflow_map(
        wf_tune_gene,
        "tune_grid",
        resamples = folds,
        grid = 10,
        metrics = custom_metric_set,
        verbose = F
      )
    
    ## get best parameters (for ridge and en) and fitting 
    
    ### logreg
    validation_logreg_cov <- tune_results_cov %>% extract_workflow("data_logreg") %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    validation_logreg_full <- tune_results_full %>% extract_workflow("data_logreg") %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    validation_logreg_gene <- tune_results_gene %>% extract_workflow("data_logreg") %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    ### ridge
    best_ridge_cov <- tune_results_cov %>% extract_workflow_set_result("data_ridge") %>% select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
    validation_ridge_cov <- tune_results_cov %>% extract_workflow("data_ridge") %>% finalize_workflow(best_ridge_cov) %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    best_ridge_full <- tune_results_full %>% extract_workflow_set_result("data_ridge") %>% select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
    validation_ridge_full <- tune_results_full %>% extract_workflow("data_ridge") %>% finalize_workflow(best_ridge_full) %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    best_ridge_gene <- tune_results_gene %>% extract_workflow_set_result("data_ridge") %>% select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
    validation_ridge_gene <- tune_results_gene %>% extract_workflow("data_ridge") %>% finalize_workflow(best_ridge_gene) %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    ### EN
    best_en_cov <- tune_results_cov %>% extract_workflow_set_result("data_en") %>% select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
    validation_en_cov <- tune_results_cov %>% extract_workflow("data_en") %>% finalize_workflow(best_en_cov) %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    best_en_full <- tune_results_full %>% extract_workflow_set_result("data_en") %>% select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
    validation_en_full <- tune_results_full %>% extract_workflow("data_en") %>% finalize_workflow(best_en_full) %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    best_en_gene <- tune_results_gene %>% extract_workflow_set_result("data_en") %>% select_best(metric = "roc_auc")
    validation_en_gene <- tune_results_gene %>% extract_workflow("data_en") %>% finalize_workflow(best_en_gene) %>% last_fit(split =  data_split, metrics = custom_metric_set)
    
    ## collect coefficients
    coefs <- rbind(
      coefs,
      validation_logreg_cov %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% dplyr::select(term, estimate) %>% mutate(penalty = NA, model_type = "logreg", covariate_only = TRUE),
      validation_logreg_full %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% dplyr::select(term, estimate) %>% mutate(penalty = NA, model_type = "logreg", covariate_only = FALSE),
      validation_logreg_gene %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% dplyr::select(term, estimate) %>% mutate(penalty = NA, model_type = "logreg", covariate_only = FALSE),
      validation_ridge_cov %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(model_type = "ridge", covariate_only = TRUE),
      validation_ridge_full %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(model_type = "ridge", covariate_only = FALSE),
      validation_ridge_gene %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(model_type = "ridge", covariate_only = FALSE),
      validation_en_cov %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(model_type = "en", covariate_only = TRUE),
      validation_en_full %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(model_type = "en", covariate_only = TRUE),
      validation_en_gene %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% tidy() %>% mutate(model_type = "en", covariate_only = FALSE)
    )
    
    ## collect predictions
    pred_cur_logreg_cov <- validation_logreg_cov %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_cov = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_cov = .pred_class, truth = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_logreg_full <- validation_logreg_full %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_full = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_full = .pred_class, truth_full = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_logreg_gene <- validation_logreg_gene %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_gene = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_gene = .pred_class, truth_gene = {{outcome_col}})
    
    pred_cur_ridge_cov <- validation_ridge_cov %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_cov = .pred_Resilient,  .pred_class_cov = .pred_class, truth = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_ridge_full <- validation_ridge_full %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_full = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_full = .pred_class, truth_full = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_ridge_gene <- validation_ridge_gene %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_gene = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_gene = .pred_class, truth_gene = {{outcome_col}})
    
    pred_cur_en_cov <- validation_en_cov %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_cov = .pred_Resilient,  .pred_class_cov = .pred_class, truth = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_en_full <- validation_en_full %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_full = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_full = .pred_class, truth_full = {{outcome_col}})
    pred_cur_en_gene <- validation_en_gene %>% collect_predictions() %>% dplyr::select({{outcome_col}}, .pred_class, .pred_Resilient, .row) %>% rename(.pred_prob_gene = .pred_Resilient, .pred_class_gene = .pred_class, truth_gene = {{outcome_col}})
    
    pred_logreg <- pred_cur_logreg_cov %>% left_join(pred_cur_logreg_full, by = ".row") %>% left_join(pred_cur_logreg_gene, by = ".row") %>%  mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    pred_ridge <- pred_cur_ridge_cov %>% left_join(pred_cur_ridge_full, by = ".row") %>% left_join(pred_cur_ridge_gene, by = ".row") %>%  mutate(model_type = "ridge")
    pred_en <- pred_cur_en_cov %>% left_join(pred_cur_en_full, by = ".row") %>% left_join(pred_cur_en_gene, by = ".row") %>% mutate(model_type = "en")
    
    # Check that truth is identical
    if (!all(
      pred_logreg$truth == pred_logreg$truth_full & pred_ridge$truth == pred_ridge$truth_full & pred_en$truth == pred_en$truth_full &
      pred_logreg$truth == pred_logreg$truth_gene & pred_ridge$truth == pred_ridge$truth_gene & pred_en$truth == pred_en$truth_gene
    )) {
      stop(
        "The three last_fit objects do not appear to contain
       predictions for the same observations in the same order."
      )
    }
    
    preds <- rbind(
      preds,
      pred_logreg,
      pred_ridge,
      pred_en
    ) %>% 
      dplyr::select(-truth_full, -truth_gene) %>% 
       relocate(.row, .before = "truth")
    
    
    ## collect metrics
    ### get the point estimates
    point_logreg_cov <- cal_metrics(pred_logreg, prob_col = ".pred_prob_cov", class_col = ".pred_class_cov") %>% rename(.estimate_cov = .estimate)
    point_logreg_full <- cal_metrics(pred_logreg, prob_col = ".pred_prob_full", class_col = ".pred_class_full") %>% rename(.estimate_full = .estimate)
    point_logreg_gene <- cal_metrics(pred_logreg, prob_col = ".pred_prob_gene", class_col = ".pred_class_gene") %>% rename(.estimate_gene = .estimate)
    point_logreg <- point_logreg_cov %>% left_join(point_logreg_full, by = ".metric") %>% left_join(point_logreg_gene, by = ".metric") %>% mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    
    point_ridge_cov <- cal_metrics(pred_ridge, prob_col = ".pred_prob_cov", class_col = ".pred_class_cov") %>% rename(.estimate_cov = .estimate)
    point_ridge_full <- cal_metrics(pred_ridge, prob_col = ".pred_prob_full", class_col = ".pred_class_full") %>% rename(.estimate_full = .estimate)
    point_ridge_gene <- cal_metrics(pred_ridge, prob_col = ".pred_prob_gene", class_col = ".pred_class_gene") %>% rename(.estimate_gene = .estimate)
    point_ridge <- point_ridge_cov %>% left_join(point_ridge_full, by = ".metric") %>% left_join(point_ridge_gene, by = ".metric") %>% mutate(model_type = "ridge")
    
    point_en_cov <- cal_metrics(pred_en, prob_col = ".pred_prob_cov", class_col = ".pred_class_cov") %>% rename(.estimate_cov = .estimate)
    point_en_full <- cal_metrics(pred_en, prob_col = ".pred_prob_full", class_col = ".pred_class_full") %>% rename(.estimate_full = .estimate)
    point_en_gene <- cal_metrics(pred_en, prob_col = ".pred_prob_gene", class_col = ".pred_class_gene") %>% rename(.estimate_gene = .estimate)
    point_en <- point_en_cov %>% left_join(point_en_full, by = ".metric") %>% left_join(point_en_gene, by = ".metric") %>% mutate(model_type = "en")
    
    
    metrics <- rbind(
      metrics,
      point_logreg,
      point_ridge,
      point_en
    ) %>% 
      mutate(delta_metric = .estimate_full - .estimate_cov, .after = ".estimate_full")
    
    
    ## calculate 95% CI of metrics
    boots_logreg <- boostrap_ci_fn(dat = pred_logreg) %>% mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    boots_ridge <- boostrap_ci_fn(dat = pred_ridge) %>% mutate(model_type = "ridge")
    boots_en <- boostrap_ci_fn(dat = pred_en) %>% mutate(model_type = "en")
    boots <- rbind(boots_logreg, boots_ridge, boots_en)

    metrics <- metrics %>%
      left_join(boots, by = c(".metric", "model_type")) %>%
      dplyr::select(model_type, .metric, everything())
    
    
    ## perform ROC AUC test
    auc_comp_logreg = roc_sig_test(dat = pred_logreg) %>% mutate(model_type = "logreg")
    auc_comp_ridge = roc_sig_test(dat = pred_ridge) %>% mutate(model_type = "ridge")
    auc_comp_en = roc_sig_test(dat = pred_en) %>% mutate(model_type = "en")
   
    auc_comp <- rbind(
      auc_comp,
      auc_comp_logreg,
      auc_comp_ridge,
      auc_comp_en
    )
  }
  
  # Final storage 
  list(
    metrics_all = metrics,
    preds_all   = preds,
    coef_all    = coefs,
    auc_comp    = auc_comp
  )
}

run_modeling <- function(
  train_data,
  test_data,
  outcome_cols, 
  gene_vars,
  covars,
  mode = c("separate", "all")
){
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  
  # store all results by outcome
  results <- list()
  
  for (outcome in outcome_cols) {
    print(paste0("OUTCOME: ", outcome))
    
    results[[outcome]] <- list()
    
    ## ----------------------------------------------------------
    ## MODE 1: EACH GENE SEPARATELY
    ## ----------------------------------------------------------
    if (mode == "separate") {
      
      separate_list <- list()
      
      for (g in gene_vars) {

        print(paste0("Running gene: ", g))
        
        separate_list[[g]] <-
          modeling(
            train_data    = train_data,
            test_data     = test_data,
            outcome_col   = outcome,
            covar_col     = covars,
            gene_col      = g,
            mode          = mode
          )
      }
      
      results[[outcome]] <- separate_list
    }
    
    ## ----------------------------------------------------------
    ## MODE 2: ALL GENES AT ONCE
    ## ----------------------------------------------------------
    if (mode == "all") {

      print("Running: all genes together")
      
      results[[outcome]] <-
        modeling(
          train_data    = train_data,
          test_data     = test_data,
          outcome_col   = outcome,
          covar_col     = covars,
          gene_col      = gene_vars,
          mode          = mode
        )
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}


```

| Res_X.CL_Y.Mem   | With centiloids, memory as outcome |

## ROC curves
Plot for NDUFA9, NDUFV1, NDUFB8.
These are in Fig.3c and Extended Data Fig.12e
```{r LMDR no CL}
load("/fslustre/labs/ext_tsai_wei_mayo_edu/ro1_resilience/Manuscript/Rebuttal_2nd/outdir/1_6/results.RData")

genes <- c("NDUFA9", "NDUFV1", "NDUFB8")
# helper function to create dataframe for plotting roc curves
make_roc_data <- function(res_object, genes) {

  map_dfr(genes, function(gene) {

    preds <- res_object[[gene]]$preds_all

    aucs <- res_object[[gene]]$metrics_all %>%
      filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Covar = .estimate_cov,
        Full = .estimate_full,
        Gene = .estimate_gene
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = everything(),
        names_to = "Model",
        values_to = "AUC"
      )

    roc_dat <- preds %>%
      dplyr::select(truth, Covar = .pred_prob_cov, Full = .pred_prob_full, Gene = .pred_prob_gene) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -truth, names_to = "Model", values_to = ".pred") %>%
      group_by(Model) %>%
      group_modify(~ roc_curve(.x, truth = truth, .pred)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      left_join(aucs, by = "Model") %>%
      mutate(
        Gene = gene,
        lbl = paste0(Model, " (AUC = ", sprintf("%.2f", AUC),")")
      )

    roc_dat
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      Gene = factor(Gene, levels = genes),
      Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Covar", "Gene", "Full")
      )
    )
}

roc_m2a_4p <- make_roc_data(res_object = m2a_sep$Res_X.Age_Y.LMDR, genes = genes)
roc_a2m_4p <- make_roc_data(res_object = a2m_sep$Res_X.Age_Y.LMDR, genes = genes)

# helper function for plotting ROC curves
plot_roc_models <- function(roc_data, plot_title) {

  auc_labels <- roc_data %>%
    distinct(Gene, Model, AUC) %>%
    arrange(Gene, Model) %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    mutate(
      x_pos = 0.98,
      y_pos = c(0.18, 0.11, 0.04),
      label = paste0(Model, ": AUC = ", sprintf("%.2f", AUC))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(
    roc_data,
    aes(
      x = 1 - specificity,
      y = sensitivity,
      color = Model
    )
  ) +
    geom_path() +
    geom_abline(lty = 3) +
    geom_text(
      data = auc_labels,
      aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label, color = Model),
      hjust = 1,
      size = 9/.pt,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Gene) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Covar" = "tomato",
        "Gene"      = "limegreen",
        "Full"      = "turquoise"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Covariate only",
        "Gene only",
        "Full model"
      ),
      name = "Model"
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "1 − Specificity", y = "Sensitivity") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic")
    )
}
p1 <- plot_roc_models(roc_m2a_4p, "Train: MCSA \u2192 Test: ADNI")
p2 <- plot_roc_models(roc_a2m_4p, "Train: ADNI \u2192 Test: MCSA")

p1
p2
```
